Schools ask their students the strangest essay questions sometimes. The experience of tutoring anxious teenagers through how to answer them requires a balladier, singing their lived experience to a crowd as though it were the Middle Ages.
Milo Cramer ’s show School Pictures was recorded at Playwrights Horizons.
